page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top with the page number to its right. Commentary in paragraphs, a centred heading "Partitio." and a centred heading "ARGVMENTVM." further down. Signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Non enim suus heres.) Enunc.1.Prius legis caput ad eos tantum, qui quo tempore nascuntur sui heredes, sunt, pertinet.
Iam natus erit.) Sequitur 2.Posteriore capite non alius, quàm qui natus iam erit, succedendo rumpere prohibetur.
Vt liceat instituí.) Sequitur 3.Prius caput eos qui nondum nati, sui erunt cum nascentur, instituí permittit.
Non permittit instituí.) Sequitur 4.Posterius caput non instituí noua formula permittit, sed à succedentibus rumpi testamentum vetat.
Nullo iure potuit.) Seq. 5. Qui ante testatoris mortem non suus nascitur, nec XII, nec Vellea lege rectè instituitur.
Inducere legem.) Sequitur 6. Testamentum quod ex uno tantum legis capite valere non potest, coniunctione alte-rius adiuvatur.

page.notes: Running head reads "IN L. GALLVS" with a stylised L. Page number 241 printed at top right. Catchword "lio" completes "filio". The signature "q" is at the foot left. "Testamen" at the end of a line may carry a printed hyphen that is hard to see, so I wrote "Testamentum" whole. "XII" in the Nullo iure line is printed in a form that could be a lowercase x; read as XII. "instituí" and "instituì" have accents that are hard to tell apart; read as printed with an acute. Text ends mid-word "fi-" with the hyphen printed.
